title: Stratum usage batch v1
description: Body of POST /api/internal/usage: what each request through a gateway consumed (ADR-0009). Metadata only: never prompts, completions or credentials. Same compatibility rule as the sync contract: adding optional fields is compatible; removing or retyping one is not. The control plane skips records it cannot store and refuses a batch only when the batch itself is malformed.

instance_id.description: The reporting gateway's instance ID. Must match the sync token when present.

id.description: UUID chosen by the gateway; the idempotency key. A record sent again with the same id and ts is stored once.

ts.description: When the request arrived (RFC 3339). Records older than 35 days or more than 5 minutes ahead of the control plane's clock are skipped.

request_id.description: The X-Request-Id the gateway returned to the client.

key_id.description: ID of the API key as the sync sent it: a user ID, or agent:<agent id>.

team_id.description: Team of the key. Ignored unless it belongs to the gateway's organization.

model.description: Model as sent to the provider (without the provider prefix).

status.description: HTTP status returned to the client (499: the client went away).

reason.description: Short code: ok, or why the request failed or was refused.

upstream_ms.description: Time until the provider's response headers.

content_flags.description: Kinds of sensitive data the policy's PII/DLP rules found (never the data).
